_comment: Curated figures and short quotes for the 'What Companies Report' section of the Mexican Consumer page. Every value and quote is taken from the company's own results release (stored as text under raw/releases/ by the harvester) and carries the text it was read from (`find`): the builder refuses a record whose text is not in the stored document of the release dated `filed`, or whose number is not in its text. Figures are the ones the company gives for Mexico (or for the narrowest segment that contains it, named in `segment`). comp = same-store sales, sales = total sales, traffic, ticket: year-over-year change in percent. npl = past-due loan ratio (`prev`: a year earlier, read from the same text; `chgBp`: the change in basis points the text states). extra: other figures, each with `label` and `unit` (chg = signed percent change, rate = percent, mm = millions, n = count, usdBn = billions of U.S. dollars). Updated by the daily upkeep task the day a release is stored; `reviewed` is the date of the last pass.
